subject: Re: Kickoff: Didi digital-ink benchmark hosting
body:
Dmitri,

Resourcing update. Data hosting is on track: Amara has the raw NDJSON ink mirrored into Corpus and the TFRecord conversion running as a scheduled pipeline; the png/dot/xdot prompt files land this week.

On 'a standard way to compare results' -- that needs real software, not a spreadsheet. We are scoping and staffing a benchmark leaderboard service built from scratch: Chiara Olsen at 60% and Farah Haddad at 40% through April to design and build it. Feature set: submission upload, automatic scoring against the held-out test split, per-task breakdowns, and an internal results page. Katya stays 30% on the baseline model so the leaderboard has a reference entry on day one.

Compute ask is minimal, a few Titan A100s for the baseline.

One watch item: scoring rules need to be nailed down before submissions open, else early numbers wont be comparable.

Ivo
